summary: Temporary seat pool request for RLHF evaluation — burst capacity + cost-center tagging
description:
Issue summary:
Requesting a temporary pool of SaaS seats to support an internal RLHF (reinforcement learning from human feedback) model evaluation campaign. The ML research team needs burst access for ~8 data scientists/annotators for a 6-week evaluation window.

Impact:
- Without additional seats, the RLHF experiment will be delayed by 3+ weeks, impacting the Q2 roadmap for latency and cost-optimizations tied to model rollout.
- Team productivity impacted for research and policy review (annotation workflows blocked).

Request details:
- Product: New vendor evaluation (annotation and model comparison workspace) — vendor: Lumiedge (vendor trial license).
- Seat count: 8 floating seats + 2 admin seats (10 total).
- Duration: 6 weeks (2026-03-22 to 2026-05-03).
- Billing: Charge to cost-center MIL-PLATFORM-RESEARCH (please add billing tag).
- Requested features: SCIM provisioning via Okta, SSO, data residency in us-east, audit log access for compliance.

Justification and approvals:
- Request approved by: Priya Menon (ML Research Lead) — approval email included in comments.
- Business justification: Time-boxed RLHF evaluation to validate reward-model improvements and measure token cost tradeoffs across model variants.

Procurement constraints / security notes:
- Vendor has not completed full security questionnaire; security team requires SOC2 summary and encryption-in-transit confirmation before production data is used. For evaluation only non-sensitive synthetic datasets will be used.
- Need temporary NDA addendum (vendor signed version pending).

Provisioning steps (requested):
1) Procurement to complete vendor onboarding and sign trial agreement.
2) Request IT to configure SCIM group mapping with Okta and enable automatic seat assignment to the research group (redwood-rlhf-eval).
3) Finance to tag the invoice with MIL-PLATFORM-RESEARCH cost center and set spend cap of $4,000 for trial period.
4) Security to review vendor questionnaire and approve synthetic-data usage.

Attachments/References:
- Approval email thread (see comments).
- Proposed billing estimate from vendor attached in comments.

Minimum success criteria:
- Seats provisioned and SCIM group syncing within 5 business days of procurement sign-off.
- Billing tag applied and invoice routing confirmed.
- Security confirms synthetic-data-only evaluation allowed and logs enabled.
